requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Drawer is on piece:0,0,0;half-n (key s) and spike spike:0#0,1|1,0|1,1 is at the nearest allowed three-base corner. The configurator refused addSpike at junction [0,0-0,1-1,0] when the drawer was present with SPIKE_CLASH and offered no alternative at that exact junction, so both cannot occupy the same corner. Build contains one drawer and one spike on the same 4-cell cluster, but on different corners, not touching at the same corner.

finish.summary: Built 4 bases with one drawer and one spike. Exact same-corner touching was refused by the configurator (SPIKE_CLASH at the shared junction); spike placed at the nearest permissible corner instead.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your one-drawer, one-spike corner is on the bench — I'll set them to meet at the same cell.

result.note: A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base (variant half-n, half-s, half-e or half-w) first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: I've got a base cell ready — now I'll get your drawer and spike touching at the same corner.
